messages.text: Happy to check. What's the email on the order?

Your order is paid and hasn't shipped yet. The Magic Miner 40T is a Batch 5 pre-sale unit and ships November 14, with the Power Kit and Miner Duster going out in the same box to (address hidden). Tracking goes to this email automatically when it leaves the warehouse.
No I ordered mine July 17 I’m batch 1

You're right, that one's Wave 1, not Batch 5. My mistake.

We wrote to you on September 27: the manufacturer upgraded the hardware, and the new ship date is October 31. Your $649 price is locked, and the free Duster and Power Kit stay on the order. That email also carried a $50 code for your next order, worth digging out of your inbox or spam.

That's the B30, order Shop···· from July 17, with the free Power Kit on it. It ships October 30.

Same as the other one, it's paid and nothing has left the warehouse yet. Tracking goes to this email when it does.

Close, just so the two don't get mixed up: the Magic Miner 40T is October 31, the B30 is October 30. A day apart.

Anything else I can check for you?
Okay so both are expected to ship out at the end of October
That's it. Both go out at the end of October, the B30 on the 30th and the Magic Miner on the 31st.
Before you go, one thing: you had the B30 on order already when you added the Magic Miner two weeks later. What made you want both?
The dollar per th/s & costs under $800 on top of the coupons I was able to apply on both units.  Also the efficiency of the miner especially the B30 with the new chips.
Makes sense. Where's your cutoff on dollars per TH, the number where you'd stop and not buy?
Good to know. Anything else you've had your eye on lately, or are those two it for now?
I only bought both because I was about to buy a s21 xp 270th/s for $2k used
That's a useful comparison, thanks for telling me. Enjoy the wait, both are worth it.
Anytime. A copy of this chat lands in your inbox once we're done here, so you'll have both dates in writing.
